# Landing page conversion audit

## When to use

- Why isn't this landing page converting
- Review the checkout flow for conversion leaks
- Our paid traffic is not converting, audit the sales page
- CRO review of the opt-in page
- Find revenue leaks on the product page

## Procedure

1. Map the funnel from ad click to purchase.
2. Score each step for friction and trust.
3. Return fixes ordered by expected revenue impact.
